description: This file provides range and tuple support for the {fmt} formatting library, including range detection, formatting, and utilities for various container-like types and tuples.

classes.name: is_map
classes.description: Type trait to check if a type is a map (has a mapped_type).

classes.name: is_set
classes.description: Type trait to check if a type is a set (has a key_type and is not a map).

classes.name: has_member_fn_begin_end_t
classes.description: Trait to detect if a type has member begin() and end() functions.

classes.name: has_const_begin_end
classes.description: Trait to detect if a type has const begin() and end() functions.

classes.name: has_mutable_begin_end
classes.description: Trait to detect if a type has mutable begin() and end() functions.

classes.name: is_range_
classes.description: Trait to determine if a type is a range.

classes.name: is_tuple_like_
classes.description: Trait to check if a type is tuple-like (supports std::tuple_size).

classes.name: is_tuple_formattable_
classes.description: Trait to check if a tuple-like type is formattable.

classes.name: range_reference_type_impl
classes.description: Helper to determine reference type of a range.

classes.name: range_formatter
classes.description: Formatter for range types, supporting various formats including debug and string.

classes.name: range_format_kind
classes.description: Determines the kind of range format (disabled, map, set, sequence, string, debug_string).

classes.name: join_view
classes.description: View for joining range elements with a separator.

classes.name: tuple_join_view
classes.description: View for joining tuple elements with a separator.

classes.name: is_container_adaptor_like
classes.description: Detects if a type is a container adaptor (e.g., stack, queue).

methods.name: range_begin
methods.description: Returns the beginning iterator of a range or array.

methods.name: range_end
methods.description: Returns the end iterator of a range or array.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Main formatting function for ranges, tuples, and container-like types.
